metadata.description: Agent Skills for security scanning, text classification, reasoning analysis and local models on Apple Silicon

plugins.name: frame-security-scan
plugins.description: Scan Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C# and C/C++ code with the open-source Frame CLI, triage findings, generate and verify fixes, and re-scan. Also connects the frame MCP server (uvx frame-mcp)

plugins.name: adaptive-classifier
plugins.description: Build, update and evaluate text classifiers that learn new examples and classes without retraining from scratch

plugins.name: pts-pivotal-token-search
plugins.description: Find the tokens, sentences and latent concepts that change whether a language model solves a task, with PTS

plugins.name: optiq-local-models
plugins.description: Serve a quantized language model on an Apple Silicon Mac with mlx-optiq and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
